title: Selected for Kyung Hee University's Top Academic Excellence Award (최우수학술상) in Architecture
summary: Top Academic Excellence Award (최우수학술상) from the Graduate School of Kyung Hee University.
details: Selected as the recipient of the Top Academic Excellence Award (최우수학술상) by the Graduate School of Kyung Hee University, representing the Department of Architecture within the Arts & Physical Education (예체능) division, among the Fall 2025 (August 2026) graduate award recipients, in recognition of outstanding research achievements in Architecture.

summary: Accepted in the Journal of Civil Engineering and Management.

title: 'Cross-platform framework for semantic BIM-to-XR data exchange in immersive construction informatics' accepted in Automation in Construction
summary: New journal acceptance in Automation in Construction (IF: 12.6).
details: A cross-platform framework for semantic BIM-to-XR data exchange in immersive construction informatics has been accepted in Automation in Construction. The work extends the BIMUniXchange pipeline toward fully semantic, immersive AEC workflows across Revit, ArchiCAD, and Unity.

title: Successfully defended my doctoral thesis on April 1, 2026
summary: PhD thesis defense completed at Kyung Hee University.
details: Successfully defended my doctoral thesis, 'A Semantically Enriched BIM to XR Data Exchange Framework with Conversational LLM for Immersive Construction Informatics,' at the Department of Architecture, Kyung Hee University, under the supervision of Professor Inhan Kim.

images.caption: Kyung Hee University, Department of Architecture
